tree_history_empty: No changes have been recorded yet.
tree_history_premium_description: Keep and restore 30 days of changes across your entire outline.
tree_history_restore_deletion_first: This node is deleted. Restore its deletion entry before restoring an earlier change.
settings_general_description: Choose default behavior for your outlines.
settings_hide_completed_default_descript: Hide completed tasks by default in every outline. You can temporarily show them from Filters.
settings_due_date_notifications: Notify me when a task becomes due
settings_due_date_notifications_descript: Shows an in-app alert (and, if your browser supports it, a notification) the moment a task's due date and time arrives, while Cascade is open in a tab. It won't notify you if the tab is closed or your device is locked.

Shows an in-app alert the moment a task's due date and time arrives, while Cascade is open in a tab. Your browser doesn't support notifications outside the app, and it won't notify you if the tab is closed or your device is locked.
settings_notification_permission_denied: Browser notifications are blocked. You'll still see in-app notifications while Cascade is open.
settings_notification_unsupported: Your browser doesn't support notifications outside the app. You'll still see in-app alerts while Cascade is open.
settings_appearance_description: Customize how Cascade looks and how your outline is displayed.
settings_theme_description: Choose a theme or follow your system appearance.
settings_typography_description: Adjust the typeface and text size throughout the app.
settings_layout_description: Control the spacing used to show nested nodes.
settings_language_description: Choose the language used throughout Cascade.
settings_account_description: Review your profile, session, and account controls.
settings_sign_out_description: End your current session on this device.
settings_export_description: Download a complete JSON copy of your account data, including nodes, tags, due dates, tree history, and settings.
settings_delete_account_description: Permanently delete your account and all of its data.
settings_security_actions_description: Quickly revoke access from every other signed-in device.
settings_premium_available_description: Request a seat to activate premium features.
settings_resources_description: Useful links and information about Cascade.
settings_changelog_description: See the latest features, improvements, and fixes.
settings_tags_description: Manage the tags available throughout your outline.
settings_tags_section_description: Renaming or deleting a tag updates every node that uses it.
settings_tags_create_description: Add a reusable tag before assigning it to nodes.
settings_tags_empty_description: Tags you create on nodes will appear here.
settings_tags_name_exists: A tag with this name already exists.

settings_statuses_description: Manage the statuses available throughout your outline.
settings_statuses_section_description: Renaming or recoloring a status updates every node that uses it.
settings_statuses_create_description: Add a status here, then assign it from a node's right-click menu or its detail page.
settings_statuses_empty_description: Statuses you create here will appear in every node's status picker.
settings_statuses_name_exists: A status with this name already exists.

security_sessions_description: Review the devices signed in to your account and revoke access you no longer recognize.

security_other_sessions_revoke_failed: Failed to sign out other sessions
user_menu_delete_confirm_body: This permanently deletes your account and all information we have, like your nodes.
user_menu_delete_confirm_warning: This action is final, there is absolutely no way of restoring your information!
user_menu_premium_description: Request a premium seat to unlock upcoming premium features.
user_menu_premium_free_notice: Premium is free to request for now. In the future, access will be restricted and this will become a paid feature.

keyboard_shortcuts_focus_next: Move focus to the next node

keyboard_shortcuts_delete_empty: Delete an empty node and focus the previous one

keyboard_shortcuts_outdent: Outdent, moving it up a level
keyboard_shortcuts_move_up: Move the node up among its siblings
keyboard_shortcuts_move_down: Move the node down among its siblings
onboarding_tour_welcome_description: This outline has a few example nodes ready to explore. Want a 30-second tour of the basics first?
onboarding_tour_add_node_description: Press Enter at the end of a node to add a new one below it, or click the “Add node” button at the bottom of the outline.
onboarding_tour_filters_title: Filter by tag or due date
onboarding_tour_filters_description: Narrow the outline down to tagged nodes, tasks due today, or hide completed tasks.
onboarding_tour_quick_open_description: Press Cmd/Ctrl+K anytime to jump straight to any node by name.
onboarding_tour_user_menu_description: Your profile menu has appearance settings, tree history, and account options. Press ? anytime for the full keyboard shortcuts reference.
settings_replay_tour_description: Show the guided tour of core features again.
onboarding_tour_indent_description: Press Tab to indent a node under the one above it, Shift+Tab to outdent, or drag a row to reorder or re-parent it.
onboarding_tour_focus_dot_description: Click the dot to the left of any node to open it on its own page — the outline narrows down to just that node and its children.
onboarding_tour_task_description: Click a task's checkbox to mark it complete.
onboarding_tour_tagged_description: Nodes can have tags and due dates — use Filters above the outline to narrow down by either.
outliner_status_empty: No statuses yet — create one in Settings → Statuses.
